hook.name: BuybackHook
hook.description: Implements laddered single-sided limit orders (buyback/sell rungs) on Uniswap v4 pools. When price crosses a rung's tick range during a swap, the hook fills the rung and routes proceeds per an exit policy: keep as a claimable, extract to the owner, or reroll into an opposite-direction return leg. Extends LimitOrderHook with owner-scoped accounting and a configurable protocol fee.
